plan.summary: BRO-6880: recompute contentTier on the WaPo Imaginary Invalid section whose wrongShow was cleared by a verified retry but kept its invalid tier.
steps: BRO-6880: the targeted collect stored only this show's section of the WaPo three-show column, it passed content verification (columnSectionIsolated) and the retry cleared the verifier-set wrongShow, but contentTier stayed 'invalid' ('Wrong show') and incompleteReason wrong_content, so the rebuild drops it. Recompute the tier from the stored 925-char section (classifyContentTier gives truncated, 137 words) and drop the stale wrong_content reason. Same class as BRO-5356 l/m/n; consent-refetch.js now does this at clear time.
